title: ci-local.sh: the newly added input-parity gate is dead — both full-suite run_gates calls still cap at 8
evidence:
line 5: `#   tools/ci-local.sh                 # all 9 gates in a linux container (the ubuntu leg)`
line 63: `  "Input parity (T1 across inputs — mouse == touch == controller)|tools/harness.sh input-parity"`
line 162 (run_native): `  run_gates "$([ "$FAST" -eq 1 ] && echo 2 || echo 8)"`
line 227 (--in-container dispatch): `  run_gates "$([ "$FAST" -eq 1 ] && echo 2 || echo 8)"`
GATES= (line 54) now holds 9 entries; the file header (line 9) says: `# The gate list mirrors .github/workflows/ci.yml step-for-step — the workflow is the spec; never edit one without the other.`
detail: The delta added the input-parity gate and reworded the docs to 'all 9 gates' but never bumped the two full-suite counts, so the new gate is unreachable locally (container AND native); only GH CI runs it. The delta's own docs and the CI-mirror contract are now false.
recommended_fix: Change both full-suite counts to 9: `run_gates "$([ "$FAST" -eq 1 ] && echo 2 || echo 9)"` in run_native (line 162) and the --in-container dispatch (line 227).

title: mouse_map now mutates selection state at map time, breaking the module's documented mapping-purity contract
evidence:
lines 27-29: `// mouse_map — convert a frame's mouse/keyboard Device_Events into Intents.` / `// The mapping mutates only the input-surface anchor bookkeeping (press,` / `// press_swallowed) — every command/state mutation happens in the executor.`
lines 141-148: `// QUEUED (it executes after the mapping), so mirror the deselect into` / `// map-time state NOW: the press branch's on_ui_press reads the ctx.` / `if esc_deselect {` / `inp.sel_pipe = -1` / `inp.sel_node = -1` / `}`
exec.odin:44-58 — the executor's Cancel already owns the deselect: `if inp.placing >= 0 { inp.placing = -1; inp.drag = {}; inp.drag.placing = -1 } else { inp.sel_pipe = -1; inp.sel_node = -1 }`
detail: This is the only selection mutation outside the executor, a precedent future mappings can copy, and the file's own doc comment is now false. The map-time clear exists solely so the on_ui_press hook (map-time) sees no selection — the executor deselects anyway.
recommended_fix: Gate the hook instead of the state: skip `inp.on_ui_press(...)` when `esc_deselect` is set, delete the map-time sel mutation, let the executor's Cancel deselect, and restore the doc comment.

title: parity_ui_press_effect hand-copies popover_click's hit-test instead of the file's own shared-helper no-drift pattern
evidence:
harness/parity.odin:125-137: `parity_ui_press_effect :: proc(user: rawptr, ictx: ^inp.Input, pos: rl.Vector2) -> bool {` / `if ictx.sel_node >= 0 {` / `slot, ok := pp.node_slot(ictx.topo, u32(ictx.sel_node))` / `if ok && ictx.topo.node_kind[slot] == .Junction {` / `anchor := rnd.node_screen(ictx.view, ictx.topo.node_pos[slot])` / `pop := rnd.popover_rect(ictx.view, anchor, rnd.POPOVER_H_NODE)` / `if rl.CheckCollisionPointRec(pos, rnd.demolish_button_rect(pop)) {` / `inp.demolish_node(ictx, u32(ictx.sel_node))` — the same geometry as app/main.odin:751-759 popover_click.
The file's own precedent (harness/parity.odin:115-118): `// the app's effect_right_click delegates to the same helper — the parity` / `// hook must too, or the pin drifts from the app (Perkins note)` / `inp.right_click_select(ictx, pos)`; app/main.odin:660-663: `// the body lives in the input package (right_click_select) — ONE copy,` / `// shared with the harness parity hook (Perkins note: no drift)`
detail: The right-click pin was deliberately routed through a shared input-package helper to prevent exactly this; the new B1 hook duplicates the popover rect math inline (junction leg only). App-side hit-test changes silently desynchronize the pin.
recommended_fix: Extract the demolish-button hit-test into a shared input-package helper (mirroring inp.right_click_select) and call it from both effect_ui_press and parity_ui_press_effect.

title: Fix delta introduced a one-tab indentation regression in the new ESC if/else
evidence: lines 123-128: `case .Esc:` / `if inp.placing >= 0 {` / `esc_cancelled = true` / `} else {` / `esc_deselect = true` / `}` — `esc_cancelled = true` sits at the `if`'s indent (3 tabs) instead of the body's (4 tabs, matching `esc_deselect = true`).
detail: The rewritten ESC branch is the only mis-indented block in the file; the delta touched these lines but did not keep the file's own layout. Cosmetic, but it is a convention regression introduced by the fix commit.
recommended_fix: Add one tab to `esc_cancelled = true` so it aligns under the `if` body with `esc_deselect = true`.
